description:
Car games for kids and racing games for kids—made safer, kinder, and more meaningful.

Dinosaur Police Car is a kid-friendly driving game where fast fun meets learning through play. Drive exciting police vehicles, explore big worlds, and help mischievous dinosaurs return to the Dino Safety Center—safely and kindly.

New Update Highlights
• New scenes: Rainstorm Jungle & Post-Typhoon City with extreme-weather road challenges
• 17 new levels with more routes and adventures

Car Games for Kids: Fast, Simple, Joyful
Zoom through city streets, underground railways, snowy mountains, oceans, and deep underwater worlds.

Easy controls make this one of the best car games for kids and racing games for kids—great for preschoolers and young kids.

Short missions, big smiles—perfect for quick play or family time.
Racing Games for Kids with a Caring Mission
Turn on the siren, follow tracks, and find wandering dinos who caused little trouble.
Guide them back to safety while building positive habits:
• Follow rules
• Help others
• Travel safely

8 Awesome Vehicles to Drive
Switch between 8 vehicles to match every terrain:
police car, mountain vehicle, snowmobile, patrol boat, submarine, helicopter, and more.
More choices mean more fun in these car games for kids—and more adventure in racing games for kids.

Surprises in Every Scene
Collect supply drops and underwater pearls.
Meet playful ocean friends like ink-squirting squids and electric eels.
Interactive moments spark curiosity, imagination, and confidence.

Why Parents Trust It
• No third-party ads
• Offline play supported
• Designed for young children
• Encourages learning, focus, and safe decision-making
